title: Teri Payal Mere Geet
desc: Premi makes a living by selling poems to Benni and falls in love with a courtesan, Laila Jaan. However, he leaves her after finding the truth about her but tries to get back with her.

title: Kudrat
desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

title: Preetam
desc: Raised by his aunt and uncle, orphaned Preetam grows up to become a man who cares for others; Preetam and Anil grow up like brothers, but dark undercurrents of a messy past threaten to destroy the solace and peace Preetam has in his present.
